status.en: 81 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 29% fewer than the week before, most of them in Gaza, Jerusalem and Hebron.
status.nb: 81 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 29 prosent færre enn uken før, flest i Gaza, Jerusalem og Hebron.

summary.en: Gadi Eisenkot is tasked with forming a new Israeli government while heavy rains flood tens of thousands of displacement tents in Gaza, damaging structures already weakened by bombings and prompting gunfire that struck tents at the Rafah site as aid teams prepare for winter storms. Israeli forces deported fourteen foreign pro-Palestinian activists arrested in the West Bank during the olive harvest and seized eight Palestinian homes in Jericho, displacing dozens of residents. A woman was killed and several people were injured when a sand embankment collapsed in Gaza. The United Nations reported 21,440 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Gadi Eisenkot har fått i oppgave å danne en ny israelsk regjering mens kraftig regn oversvømmer titusenvis av flyktningtelter i Gaza, skader strukturer som allerede er svekket av bombinger og fører til skyting som traff teltene på Rafah-området mens hjelpearbeidere forbereder seg på vinterstormer. Israelske styrker deporterte fjorten utenlandske pro-palestinske aktivister som ble arrestert på Vestbredden under olivenhøsten, og beslagla åtte palestinske boliger i Jeriko, noe som fordrev dusinvis av innbyggere. En kvinne ble drept og flere personer ble såret da en sandbank kollapset i Gaza. FN rapporterte 21 440 dødsfall knyttet til kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Gaza war
background.extract: The Gaza war is an armed conflict in the Gaza Strip and Israel, fought as part of the unresolved Israeli–Palestinian and Gaza–Israel conflicts. The war began on 7 October 2023, when Palestinian militant group Hamas led an attack on Israel, in which 1,195 Israelis and foreign nationals were killed and 251 were taken hostage. Since the start of the Israeli offensive that followed, over 74,000 Palestinians in Gaza have been killed; several studies in The Lancet indicate this figure is likely a significant undercount. Many scholarly sources and international organizations—including UN bodies, NGOs, and the International Association of Genocide Scholars—have concluded that Israel's actions in Gaza constitute genocide under international law. Several countries have also stated that genocide is occurring and have supported legal proceedings before the International Court of Justice. Israel and its supporters have denied that genocide has occurred.
background.extractNb: Krigen i Gaza er en krig mellom Israel og væpnede palestinske grupper, hovedsakelig Hamas, som har pågått på Gazastripen og i det sørlige Israel siden 7. oktober 2023. Konflikten er en del av den uløste Israel–Palestina-konflikten, og følger etter krigene i 2008–2009, 2014 og 2021.
